marco_dev: Hi folks — onboarding hit a reproducible issue with our C++ SDK. We mint ephemeral mTLS certs (TTL ~10s) per worker. During warmup some streams get a 401 mid-call and then the workers rapidly retry which triggers 429s. Anyone seen short-lived certs + burst retries before?
olivia_cs: sorry about that, Marco. Can you paste a minimal log snippet and explain how you refresh certs (per-worker vs central)?
marco_dev: sanitized logs:
```
[15:12:01] certs: GET /auth/cert -> 200 {cert_id: "c123", ttl: 10s}
[15:12:02] grpc: open stream -> 200
[15:12:04] grpc: chunk -> 401 {"error":"cert_invalid"}
[15:12:04] client: retry -> grpc open -> 429 {"error":"rate_limit"} x 8
```
marco_dev: we currently fetch cert per-worker at process start; workers reuse the same TLS socket for multiple streams.
tessa_sre: two likely culprits: 1) connection-level auth binding — if the server binds the cert to the TCP/TLS handshake, rotating certs without resetting socket can cause mid-stream 401; 2) retry fanout — many workers retrying at once push you into the burst window.
sdk-team: agreed. For the C++ SDK we recommend (A) coalesced cert refresh (singleflight), (B) a brief socket reset after a cert refresh when ttl < small threshold, and (C) client-side cert-leeway (treat ttl as ttl-3s). Example pseudo-patch:```cpp
// pseudo
opts.certGraceMs = 3000;
opts.maxInitConcurrency = 4;
opts.refreshCoalesceMs = 250; // group refreshes
opts.resetSocketOnRefresh = true; // only if socket reused
```
olivia_cs: we can also offer a temporary quota bump while you ramp to avoid noisy 429s. Want me to apply +4 rps for 24h?
marco_dev: yes please that would help for the staged rollout tomorrow. Also any jitter guidance for C++ worker pools?
tessa_sre: add randomized startup jitter (0-500ms), and exponential backoff for retries with a small cap so retries don't align. On the server side we treat handshake + first request as part of initial cost accounting; spreading handshakes helps.
quota-bot: @olivia_cs increased tenant "orbit-labs" burst quota: +4 rps for 24 hours (change-id: Q-99811).
marco_dev: implemented singleflight and reduced init concurrency to 3, added 200-400ms jitter. After ~12 minutes 401s disappeared and 429s dropped to one-off retries. Huge improvement.
olivia_cs: great — want me to add the mitigation steps to your onboarding playbook under "ephemeral mTLS patterns" and mark account status as "ramping - watch" for renewals?
marco_dev: yes please. We'll also document our cert issuer's cadence and follow-up with a short note.
sdk-team: follow-up action: we'll add a short C++ SDK note in docs about resetSocketOnRefresh and cert coalescing. Also opening an internal ticket to detect "cert-rotation mid-stream" and emit `x-cert-rotation:1` header when suspected.
tessa_sre: infra follow-up: consider adding a server-side hint when connection-bound certs are rejected so clients can choose to reset connections instead of blind retries.
olivia_cs: thanks all — glad that fixed it. Marco, ping when you want us to run a joint metric review with SRE during your prod flip.
marco_dev: will do — thanks everyone :rocket:
